title: What does the app show?
instruction: The app remembers its state in variables. Go through what happens and say what it shows.
debrief: Set overwrites the value, no matter what was there. Change works with what is already there.

rounds.title: The unread messages badge
code: when a message arrives: change unread by 1
when you open the chat: set unread to 0

steps.input: The app started and 2 messages arrived.

steps.why: One more is added to the two.
Opening the chat overwrites the value with 0. It doesn't count how many there were.

rounds.title: A basket in an online shop
code: after adding an item: set quantity to 1
when you tap +: change quantity by 1
when you tap −: change quantity by -1
when you tap Remove: set quantity to 0

steps.input: You add an item and tap + twice.
steps.q: How many are in the basket?
How many are in the basket?
steps.why: One of the three is taken away.

steps.q: How many are in the basket?
steps.why: Remove overwrites the value with 0, whatever was there.
